# Youth Advisory Panel

## Overview

Your voice is needed! Want to make a difference in the City of Westminster? Join us monthly for the Youth Advisory Panel where you get to impact how we support teens in our local community.

The Youth Advisory Panel's (YAP) purpose is for teens to provide feedback and advice to the City of Westminster community, enabling them to develop new skills and foster connections that support them in becoming impactful citizens.

### Who Can Join YAP?

- Teens that are residents of the City of Westminster
- Teens who are in 8th grade through 12th grade (including homeschoolers)

### What Does YAP Do?

- Community service project(s) and other opportunities to volunteer.
- Monthly meeting where your voice can be heard by city officials and other representatives. Hear from members of the community and city.

All time spent on YAP meetings, retreats, and summits counts towards volunteer hours. For more information on the Youth Advisory Panel including time commitments (we know you are busy) and many of the amazing reasons to join the panel, please review the [Youth Advisory Panel flyer (PDF)](https://www.cityofwestminster.us/DocumentCenter/View/1218).

## Meetings

- 6 to 7:30 pm
- 2nd Wednesday of each month, September through May
- Colorado River Room (formally known as the Multi-Purpose Room)  
  Lower Level  
  Westminster City Hall  
  4800 W 92nd Avenue  
  Westminster, CO 80031

## Council Liaison

[Mayor Nancy McNally](https://www.cityofwestminster.us/Directory.aspx?EID=99)

## Staff Liaisons

- Primary Liaison: [Lauren Shoemaker](https://www.cityofwestminster.us/Directory.aspx?EID=43), Teen Services Librarian at College Hill Library
- Secondary Liaison: [Seth Neal](https://www.cityofwestminster.us/Directory.aspx?EID=100), Assistant Recreation Coordinator

## How to Apply

Applications are accepted from April 21 to August 11, 2025.

1. Fill out the YAP Application
   
   1. [Form for returning YAP members](https://forms.office.com/g/359uQXeabs) (Only fill out if you were on YAP last year.)
   2. [New application for YAP](https://forms.office.com/g/0mgehJ7snW) (Complete this form if you are interested in joining YAP.)
2. After filling out the appropriate form, please [email your resume and a letter of reference to YAP](mailto:YAP@westminsterco.gov).

### What Leadership Opportunities Are Available in YAP?

Note: All persons who hold a Chair or Vice Chair position. All Panel Members holding leadership positions will be responsible for attending an Officer meeting prior to the regular YAP meeting.

- Chair (leadership role): Responsible for written records of the panel, helps prepare meeting agendas with Staff Liaison.
- Vice Chair (leadership role): Assumes duties of the Chair in their absence, helps Staff Liaison with other duties as needed/as desired.
- Secretary (leadership role): Notifies members of meetings, prepares written records of meetings to send to Liaison and other members.
- General members: Actively participate in meetings and activities; while this is not a leadership position, this is still a very important role to play.

### Non-Leadership Roles in YAP

- General members: Actively participate in meetings and activities; while this is not a leadership position, this is still a very important role to play.
- Community Service Subcommittee: Helps organize and communicate about optional volunteer opportunities.
